description: This file contains utility functions including a throttle implementation, class string joiner, platform detection for Mac, and command key label generator, intended to be used across a frontend application.

methods.name: throttle
methods.description: Creates a throttled version of the given function that will only execute once per specified wait period (default 200ms).

methods.name: cn
methods.description: Concatenates multiple string classes, filtering out any falsey values, to produce a space-separated class string.

methods.name: isMac
methods.description: Detects whether the current platform is macOS based on the navigator.platform string.

methods.name: cmdKeyLabel
methods.description: Returns '⌘' if running on Mac, otherwise 'Ctrl', suitable for UI command labels.

ctags.name: cn
ctags.pattern: /^export const cn = (...classes: Array<string | false | null | undefined>) =>$/

ctags.name: throttle
ctags.pattern: /^export const throttle = <T extends (...args: any[]) => void>(fn: T, wait = 200) => {$/

ctags.name: void
ctags.pattern: /^export const throttle = <T extends (...args: any[]) => void>(fn: T, wait = 200) => {$/
